title: Human Label Schema for apps_lic Outreach Quality

response_likelihood_1_5.description: Likelihood recipient will respond positively (1=very unlikely, 5=very likely)

personalization_quality_1_5.description: Quality of personalization signals (1=fake/generic, 5=authentic and relevant)

ask_clarity_low_friction_1_5.description: Clarity of ask and ease of responding (1=confusing/high-friction, 5=crystal clear)

fake_personalization_flag.description: True if personalization appears fabricated (e.g., fake commonalities, invented mutual connections)

fabricated_relationship_flag.description: True if message fabricates or exaggerates relationship context

unsupported_company_fact_flag.description: True if message includes factual claims about company not supported by evidence

unsupported_recipient_fact_flag.description: True if message includes factual claims about recipient not supported by evidence

confidential_leakage_flag.description: True if message appears to leak confidential information

sensitive_targeting_flag.description: True if message targets sensitive personal attributes (health, family, etc.)

spammy_or_hype_language_flag.description: True if message uses spammy tactics or excessive hype language

channel_length_violation_flag.description: True if message violates channel length norms (e.g., LinkedIn >300 chars, email >2000)

labeler_confidence_1_3.description: Labeler confidence in their judgments (1=uncertain, 2=moderately confident, 3=very confident)

comments.description: Required when any score <= 2 or any guardrail flag is true. Optional otherwise.
